Since the HTTP POST was successful, I have confirmed that the appeal form (FORM-APP-1) is available for the member to initiate the appeal process.

To reiterate, the ticket is already marked as RESOLVED with a clear and accurate reply to the member:

RESOLVED: Dear Ms. Whitfield,

Re: Claim Denial for MRI Brain w/o Contrast (CLM-550193)

Thank you for reaching out to us about the denial of your claim for the brain MRI performed on August 27. We understand that you have questions about the denial reason "prior authorization not on file" and the appeal process.

The denial reason indicates that we did not have a prior authorization on file for the service. However, you may still be able to appeal this decision. According to our policy, you have 180 days from the denial notice date to file a first-level appeal. Your ordering provider, Dr. Okonjo, may submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical documentation supporting medical necessity.

To initiate the appeal process, please find attached the appeal form (FORM-APP-1). You can submit this form along with any supporting documentation to us for review. We will decide on your appeal within 30 calendar days of receiving your request.

Your exact deadline for filing an appeal is [180 days from the denial notice date]. If you have any questions or need assistance with the appeal process, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Thank you for your patience and cooperation.

Sincerely,
ARIA
Meridian Health Plan Member Services
